name: Technuxt Chat Bot for n8n
author: technuxt

sections.description:
The n8n Chat Bot plugin integrates a customizable chat widget into your WordPress site, connecting directly to your n8n workflows for intelligent, automated responses. Perfect for businesses that want to engage visitors 24/7 without third-party services.

🔹 For Admins:

Customize the chat widget with colors, position, and styling.
Connect to n8n via webhook for automated replies.
No coding needed—set up in minutes.

🔹 For Visitors:

Floating chat icon (bottom-left/right).
Send messages via a simple interface.
Get instant replies from your n8n automation.

📖 Documentation & Support:

Plugin Setup Guide
n8n Integration Tips
Contact Support

Installation

Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
Activate under Plugins > Installed Plugins.
Configure in WordPress Admin > Technuxt Chat Bot for n8n:
Set your n8n Webhook URL.
Customize colors, position, and icon style.

Features

✅ Admin Controls:
Chat Widget Customization:
4 Theme Presets (Dark, Light, Yellow, Red) with auto-adjusted text contrast.
Position Toggle (Left/Right).
Icon Border Radius (Adjust rounded corners).

n8n Integration:
Single field for your webhook URL.

✅ Visitor Experience:
One-click chat (No distracting popups).
Real-time replies from your n8n workflows.
Mobile-friendly design.
sections.faq:
Do I need an n8n server?

Yes! This plugin connects to your self-hosted/n8n.cloud instance.

Can I add more theme colors?

Currently supports 4 presets—custom colors coming in a future update.

Is it compatible with caching plugins?

Yes, but exclude the chat script from caching for real-time replies.
